verdict.rationale: Poly documents a hosted MCP server at mcp.poly.app (streamable HTTP, OAuth) exposing search, fetch, and a virtual `poly` CLI, and a runtime probe confirmed it is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow. Its scriptable `poly` CLI comes with an agent skill that teaches agents to search, read, create, update, and organize files, and the Claude Code plugin grants full file access, so external agents can read and write notes without the GUI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that agent writes work via MCP/CLI, and a fully headless auth path (first MCP connection requires a browser sign-in; no public REST/OpenAPI found).
